'''Tie:''' {{legend0|#ae8bb1|50%}} {{legend0|#808080|No votes}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Kevin Cramer]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Kevin Cramer]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }}{{ElectionsND}} The '''2024 United States Senate election in North Dakota''' was held on November 5, 2024, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the state of [[North Dakota]]. [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] incumbent [[Kevin Cramer]] was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating [[North Dakota Democratic–Nonpartisan League Party|Democratic–NPL]] educator Katrina Christiansen in the general election with more than 66% of the vote. Primary elections took place on June 11, 2024, with Cramer and Christiansen winning their respective party's nomination unopposed.{{Cite web |title=2024 State Primary Election Dates |url=https://www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/2024-state-primary-election-dates |access-date=2023-05-13 |website=www.ncsl.org}} This marked the first time since [[1958 United States Senate election in North Dakota|1958]] that a Republican incumbent won re-election in this class 1 seat.
